title: Cuspidal Cubic Projective Foliations: Global Rigidity, Deformations, and Pull-Backs
summary: We study rigidity phenomena for holomorphic foliations associated with irreducible cuspidal cubics. If $C\subset\PP^2$ is such a cubic, we denote by $p$ its cusp and by $q$ its unique smooth inflection point (or flex), where the tangent line has contact of order three with the cubic. Our first main result is an intrinsic global classification through degree seven: if a foliation $\F$ of degree at most seven leaves $C$ invariant, has singular set $\{p,q\}$, the germ $\F_p$ admits a nonconstant holomorphic first integral with $C_p$ as its unique separatrix, and the reduction of $\F_q$ contains…
